description: Campaign revision 5 replaces the universally base-quantified standalone T_16(Z) theorem with an intrinsic target-interface gate. A support result now counts only after a canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) and its contribution accounting are constructed. The unchanged, dual-confirmed geometry and computation cells are carried forward by pinned artifact hashes; all other revision-4 artifacts are stale. ATT-0118 and ATT-0119 are preserved formulation refutations and are not evidence about the exact target.
